plan.decision: PD347(b) - IN-VI TAG prepared, switch tools/bench/creation_tag.json enabled=false
plan.bed: a scratch copy (stagekit.Stage.scratch) of a small claudeDev VI; in it the run CREATES one object of every class the P4 plans create (measured from the s03/s04 simulated end graphs, card chat-T3): Local (read and write), GrowableFunction (Build Array / Replace Array Subset), LeftShiftRegister + RightShiftRegister pair, DigitalNumericConstant, ArrayConstant, BooleanConstant, SelectorTunnel (on a Case), FlatSequenceOuterTunnel (on a Flat Sequence), WhileLoop, its body Diagram, a Case frame Diagram, a FlatSequenceFrame Diagram - created and deleted in the run

inputs.call: for each created object: set_description(uid, tag_text(stage, id, sim)) then get_description(uid)
inputs.predict: the read-back text equals the written text for every class; no error; handle count flat (+-100)

inputs.call: save the scratch, close it, cold-open it in a FRESH LabVIEW, get_description(uid) for every object (uid from the graph read)
inputs.predict: every tag survives save + reload with the same uid (the property is stored in the VI)

inputs.call: move one tagged node into a loop body (stagekit move_in) and read it back
inputs.predict: the tag moves with the node (Description is an object property, not position)

inputs.call: a terminal of a tagged node: owner = parse_tag(get_description(owner uid)), terminal = index in the owner's terminal list
inputs.predict: the terminal is found as tagged owner + terminal index (terminals have no Description)

inputs.call: any class whose Description write errors or does not read back
inputs.predict: recorded per class as FAIL; that class stays on the creation-map path only (the switch is never enabled for a class that failed)

predicted.note: Description (VI Scripting property of GObject) is expected writable on nodes, structures and diagrams; NOT measured - that is this plan's purpose

plan.pass_if: write-read, survive-save and survive-move hold for every listed class; then (judgement) creation_tag.json enabled may be set true
plan.runs_in: a card AFTER the experiment (rig-state not 실험중), real LabVIEW, scratch only; never on a bed or an original
